outcome: perinatal mortality (fetal death and early neonatal death)
cohort: The study included 7230 mothers from Ethiopia obtained from the EDHS 2016 survey.
finding: Maternal age (40-49 years), long preceding birth interval, and husband's secondary+ education were protective factors against perinatal mortality, while parity greater than four, rural residence, Caesarean section delivery, multiple pregnancies, institutional delivery, and a history of abortion were associated with increased perinatal mortality.
mod_finding: Caesarean section delivery was associated with increased perinatal mortality.
cross-section timing: Data was collected from the EDHS 2016 survey, reflecting perinatal mortality experienced in the 5 years preceding the survey.
